Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.action.result

Class ActionMetrics

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.action.result.ActionMetrics
public class ActionMetrics extends Object
Captures metrics and performance data for action execution. Provides detailed performance tracking and analysis.

This class encapsulates metrics functionality that was previously embedded in ActionResult.

Since:
2.0
